title: Palaeochannel detection
summary: Identifying traces of former river courses using multiple kinds of evidence.
body: Historical maps, terrain, sediment observations and seasonal imagery can suggest abandoned channels. A linear image feature alone is not proof, and a modern mapped river is not a reconstruction of its ancient course. Dated sediment and field evidence are needed to support chronology. The app displays JRC water transitions from 1984–2024 and accepts sourced historical-map GeoJSON interpretations. Lost-water pixels are investigation leads, not confirmed palaeochannels or an active score input.
